history.summary: Large 2,433 sqft '4BR' strata unit at NEWest, a 956-year quasi-freehold mixed development near Clementi. $1,228 PSF looks cheap vs the $1,576 URA median, but the $2.99M quantum sits above the deep buyer band and the low PSF is partly an artefact of an oversized/loft-type unit.
history.rating_rationale: URA appreciation reads 11.1%/yr but on only 37 txns in a 136-unit boutique — unreliable and not investment-grade. $2.99M quantum thins the buyer pool, and the 2,433 sqft footprint makes this niche (large-family own-stay, not a broad resale target). One-North/TEL tailwinds are real, but 1.5km to Clementi MRT (18 min walk) blunts them. PSF discount to median is offset by quantum and liquidity drag.
red_flags: Only 37 URA txns — appreciation rate statistically thin
$2.99M quantum above the deep liquid band
Oversized 2,433 sqft unit is niche on resale
catalysts: 956-yr lease = effectively freehold, no lease-decay drag

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Large unit, modest yield; tenant pool for a 2,400+ sqft unit is thin vs efficient 2-3BR. Mixed-use retail at base helps own-stay convenience more than rental.

history.summary: Large near-freehold 4BR in West Coast (D5) asking $1,228 psf against a verified 12-month project average of ~$1,386 psf, with a dated West Coast CRL MRT catalyst (2032). Value is genuine even after discounting for the unit's large size; the main reservation is the very large 2,433 sqft footprint, which narrows the resale buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified recent NEWest transactions average ~$1,386 psf (range $1,070-$1,647), so the $1,228 psf ask is genuinely below the project's recent market, consistent with the algo's -34.6% age-adj premium and -8.4% vs-cohort (though the cohort is thin at 4 txns). Tenure is a 956-year leasehold (from 1928) — effectively freehold, despite the 'Unknown Tenure' label and the 'very_low_psf' flag. D5 sits on the RCR/OCR fringe, favorable under v3.4 realized-forward priors (OCR ~+4.0% / RCR ~+3.5% >> CCR ~+0.7%). The West Coast CRL Phase 2 station (~11 min walk, opening 2032) is a concrete, dated catalyst within a 5-7yr hold. Trailing 11.15% CAGR (37 txns) is decent but down-weighted per backtest. Held to medium confidence because the discount partly reflects the oversized 2,433 sqft unit, which has structurally lower psf and thinner exit demand.
red_flags: Very large 2,433 sqft 4BR narrows the resale buyer pool and depresses psf vs smaller units
psf-cohort comparison rests on only 4 same-size transactions (-8.4% premium is low-confidence)
Dossier tenure shown as 'Unknown' / flagged 'very_low_psf'; actual is 956-yr leasehold from 1928 (verify on title before purchase)
catalysts: West Coast MRT (Cross Island Line Phase 2) opening ~2032, ~11 min walk — within hold horizon
Mixed-use development with ground-floor retail/F&B; near NUS, NUH, West Coast Park, West Coast Plaza
Near-freehold tenure provides long-run value floor vs surrounding 99-yr stock
